data_fields.name: named_extra_roll_one_in_n
data_fields.donor_constant: one in 9, two named monsters only

data_fields.name: silenced_shout_one_in_n
data_fields.donor_constant: one in 3 for monsters that can shout

best_idea: Pick a bark line by stacking context prefixes (attitude, fleeing, silenced, related, quest state) with a fixed fallback order, and roll the bark chance from state modifiers each tick, with a hard retry cap.
decision_why: A context-keyed line choice with a fixed fallback order and a modifier-based bark chance fits fight barks and quest-state lines; reject the religion and branch prefixes as Crawl-specific, and keep the rate per second rather than per monster move.
acceptance: A client test asserts that a fleeing unique rolls one in six per move (12 halved), against one in 21 for a plain monster; a line naming the player is never shown when the player is excluded; an empty pool falls back to the default line and never loops past ten tries.
